# VisiWise Optimization LLC

> VisiWise Optimization is a digital operations studio in Tempe, Arizona. It builds, manages and grows the digital presence of small and mid-sized service businesses: websites, local SEO, content, analytics and reporting, and the software that runs day-to-day operations.

## Key facts

- **Business type**: Digital media and marketing consultancy. Works remotely with clients across the Phoenix Valley and the United States.
- **Founded**: 2026. Founder and CEO: Shambhavi Singh.
- **Location**: Tempe, Arizona, United States.
- **Website**: https://visiwiseoptimization.com
- **Contact**: visiwiseoptimization@gmail.com
- **Serves**: law firms, healthcare practices, real estate, financial services, construction and trades, consulting and coaching.
- **How engagements work**: a one-time $299 starter build (website setup, Google Business Profile, social profile optimization, initial SEO configuration), then a flat monthly management plan on a four-month minimum term.

## Services

### Build
Custom websites and digital assets designed around how a business actually operates — design, development, hosting and launch, delivered in house.

### Manage
Software and infrastructure that keeps operations organized and online: hosting, domains and DNS, project management tooling, ongoing site updates.

### Grow
SEO and marketing built to increase visibility and bring in qualified leads: local SEO and Google Business Profile, content and blog programs, social media management, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach.

### Optimize
KPI analysis and plain-English reporting on traffic, keyword rankings, social reach and lead growth, so decisions are backed by data.

## Client work

### Lint Away Duct Cleaning (lintawayductcleaning.com)
Air duct and dryer vent cleaning company serving eight Phoenix Valley cities. VisiWise redesigned the site, rebuilt it on Next.js, Supabase and Vercel, and added a 50-page city and service architecture, schema markup, an llms.txt file and a lead-capture quote form, plus a monthly SEO article program. The business has no storefront and no Google Maps listing, so geographic pages and structured data do the work a map pin normally would.

### Green Money Momentum (greenmoneymomentum.com)
A YouTube market-analysis channel. VisiWise built the community platform around it: weekly investor notes, a real-time chat room with separate host and audience interfaces, a live market ticker, a Chrome extension in beta, and a merch storefront.
